What's New in TK-mac

Helping you keep your Mac fast and healthy.

  • ⚙️ New Control Panel: Easily manage your installed applications. Perform regular uninstalls or deep clean uninstallations, including batch-uninstalling multiple apps at once. We have also introduced firewall which allows you to block incoming and outgoing traffic from your Mac.
  • ⏱️ Custom Sampling Time: From now on you can choose between 60 seconds, 2 minutes, 10 minutes, 30 minutes, and 1 hour sampling.
  • 🪟 Menu Bar Only Mode and Hide Menu Bar: You can now hide the Dock icon and run the app entirely from your Menu Bar in the background or you can do the opposite.
  • 🔓 System Processes Unlocked: We introduced system process actions to give you full control over every process when running in system mode.
  • 🛠️ Massive Performance Polish: We squashed tons of bugs and added more optimizations to make the app significantly faster and lighter on your mac.
  • 🎁 Surprise Inside: We’ve put a secret new feature for you to discover. We could tell you where it is, but it's much more fun to find it for yourself!
